description: Simple yield model: torrefied_solid = feedstock * solid_yield; energy_density increased by 1.3x factor. T=275 degC.

unit.name: Generic Torrefaction Reactor (275 degC)
unit.source: Bergman, P.C.A. et al. (2005) ECN-C-05-073; van der Stelt et al. (2011) Biomass Bioenergy 35:3748

energy_yield.note: Fraction of feedstock energy retained in solid

energy_density_factor.note: Energy density increase vs raw biomass (1.3x)

LHV_raw_MJ_kg.note: LHV of raw dry biomass (wood chips reference)
